# NEXTLOOK

> Luxury beauty marketplace bringing top stylists, hair extensions, and virtual try-on directly to you. Beauty that comes to your doorstep.

NEXTLOOK matches customers with vetted beauty professionals, lets them virtually try on hairstyles and makeup, shop premium hair extensions, and book at-home services with upfront secure payments.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of NEXTLOOK — book stylists, try on styles, shop extensions.
- [About](/about): Our mission, values, and the team behind NEXTLOOK.
- [Find Stylists](/stylists): Browse top-rated beauty professionals.
- [Discover Map](/discover): Airbnb-style map view of nearby stylists.
- [Hair Extensions Shop](/extensions): Premium hair extensions and beauty products.
- [Virtual Try-On](/tryon): Try hairstyles and makeup with AI before booking.
- [Smart Mirror](/mirror): The NEXTLOOK Smart Mirror — at-home AI styling device.
- [Pre-order Mirror](/mirror/preorder): Reserve the NEXTLOOK Smart Mirror.
- [GlowUp Monday](/glowup-monday): Weekly rewards program with points and perks.
- [Stylist Handbook](/handbook): Professional standards for NEXTLOOK stylists.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service.

## Optional

- [Become a Stylist](/provider/signup): Apply to provide services on NEXTLOOK.
- [Become a Vendor](/vendor/signup): Sell beauty products on NEXTLOOK.
